article.title: Adjunto adverbial y estructura argumental
article.part: Voz, construcciones con se y estructura argumental — Voz, construções com se e estrutura argumental
article.chapter: Transitividad, valencia y complementación verbal — Transitividade, valência e complementação verbal

claims.summary: Defines an adverbial adjunct as information that adds circumstantial context (time, place, manner, cause, frequency) without normally forming part of the arguments selected by the verb.
Explains that while adjuncts are more flexible and can be added without changing the basic structure of the verb, their presence can help recognize them.
Provides examples of adverbial adjuncts in Portuguese sentences, such as 'ontem' indicating time and 'na biblioteca' indicating place.
